'''Brian Sabotta''' (handle '''ben_ethus''') created ''[[Forfeit Zero]]'', a webcomic about the Star Wars CCG that ran from May 2003 to November 2005.<ref name="archive">[https://comic.forfeitzero.com/ Forfeit Zero Archive], comic.forfeitzero.com. Every strip carries the credit "Written and 'Drawn' by Brian Sabotta"; every news post is signed "-ben_ethus" above the footer "Forfeit Zero - Created by Brian Sabotta". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261101200206/https://comic.forfeitzero.com/ Internet Archive]</ref> He played in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, at local tournaments at Helm's Deep and in Dormont. He wrote the reports for many of those events in the comic's news posts.<ref name="p20031006">[http://forfeitzero.comicgenesis.com/d/20031006.html "Ritualistic Beating"], news post by Brian Sabotta (ben_ethus), ''Forfeit Zero'' (6 October 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261101205646/http://forfeitzero.comicgenesis.com/d/20031006.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="p20031222">[http://forfeitzero.comicgenesis.com/d/20031222.html "Tourney Results!"], news post by Brian Sabotta (ben_ethus), ''Forfeit Zero'' (22 December 2003).</ref> In 2004 he and his friend [[Shewski]] helped build a local ''[[WARS TCG]]'' group in Pittsburgh.<ref name="p20041213">[http://forfeitzero.comicgenesis.com/d/20041213.html "Decipher Needs You! (Since they apparently can't market themselves...)"], news post by Brian Sabotta (ben_ethus), ''Forfeit Zero'' (13 December 2004).</ref>

== Star Wars CCG ==
In January 2003 Sabotta wrote that he owned nothing beyond the ''[[Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]'' boxes. He published decks on [[Game Players Network]] as ben_ethus, including an Ewok There Is Good In Him deck. Under the name "Bad News Bears" on [[DeckTech]], that deck reached #5 on the site's Top 10 SWCCG list in October 2003.<ref name="bodysnatchers">[[ben_ethus Beware The Body Snatchers!]] (Game Players Network, 20 January 2003): "I do *NOT* own any cards beyond the Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck boxes".</ref><ref name="p20031022">[http://forfeitzero.comicgenesis.com/d/20031022.html "Unfair Advantage"], news post by Brian Sabotta (ben_ethus), ''Forfeit Zero'' (22 October 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261102080357/http://forfeitzero.comicgenesis.com/d/20031022.html Internet Archive]</ref> He credited DeckTech with helping him and Shewski "get back into SWCCG".<ref name="p20040920">[http://forfeitzero.comicgenesis.com/d/20040920.html "Decktech Preview"], news post by Brian Sabotta (ben_ethus), ''Forfeit Zero'' (20 September 2004).</ref> His player rating stood at 1461 in October 2003.<ref name="p20031020">[http://forfeitzero.comicgenesis.com/d/20031020.html "Genetic Update"], news post by Brian Sabotta (ben_ethus), ''Forfeit Zero'' (20 October 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261101205851/http://forfeitzero.comicgenesis.com/d/20031020.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Forfeit Zero ==
:''Main article: [[Forfeit Zero]]''
Sabotta wrote and drew ''Forfeit Zero'' and posted a news commentary under each strip, always opening with "Greetings, blokes." The comic's plot set its heroes against the "fiendish" [[Players Committee]], though Sabotta said he was "a fan of the Player's Committee".<ref name="p20030722">[http://forfeitzero.comicgenesis.com/d/20030722.html "Cheeky Tongues"], news post by Brian Sabotta (ben_ethus), ''Forfeit Zero'' (22 July 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261102075522/http://forfeitzero.comicgenesis.com/d/20030722.html Internet Archive]</ref> In 2005 he and two friends launched Skiffit.com, a fixed-price marketplace for Star Wars CCG cards and other games, where the comic was to move.<ref name="p20051018">[http://forfeitzero.comicgenesis.com/d/20051018.html "Big Announcement!"], news post by Brian Sabotta (ben_ethus), ''Forfeit Zero'' (18 October 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261102140502/http://forfeitzero.comicgenesis.com/d/20051018.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Later ==
In March 2023 players on the Players Committee forums rediscovered the comic at its old host. On 1 November 2026 Sabotta returned to the forum as ben ethus and announced the comic's "new permanent home" at comic.forfeitzero.com. He called it "the one contribution to the hobby I was able to make aside from getting obliterated in every tournament I ever played in".<ref name="fz2026">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1451112#p1451112 Forfeit Zero Comic], ben ethus (Brian Sabotta), forum.starwarsccg.org (1 November 2026). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261101200153/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t82626.html Internet Archive].</ref>
